## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and before/after result.

## Validation

List the exact checks or reproduction, their results, and any unresolved limits.
Separate fixtures, real tool execution, method comparison and sales outcomes.

## Review boundaries

- [ ] No credentials, private customer/account data, databases or commercial pack contents are included.
- [ ] Original run/task/lease identities, source evidence, authority and budgets remain protected.
- [ ] Unknown costs/results remain unknown; technical validation is not presented as sales improvement.
- [ ] New method proposals state applicable conditions, limitations, source rights and independent evaluation requirements.
- [ ] License, version, publishing and production changes are explicit parts of the reviewed scope, if any.
